content.comment_body: I'm attempting to use a wiping relay with its reference parameter sourced from an up/down counter. Although the manual indicates this should be possible, the reference button is missing from the parameter block. This button is available for on and off delay timers but not for the wiping relay. Is there a reason for this?

Hello, You are using an older [product_name], which does not support this feature. Make sure to use the appropriate manual for your version of [product_name] to avoid similar issues in the future. Tip: If you change the hardware version in [product_name] programming software, unsupported features—such as referencing for the wiping relay—will be disabled. Regards

Thank you for your feedback. I've solved the issue, and your response was partly correct. The problem stemmed from originally creating the program in older software for a previous [product_name] version. Even with the newest software and targeting an updated [product_name], the reference button did not appear for the wiping relay. I had to start a new project from scratch, rewrite the program, and now everything functions as expected. Thanks again for your help. Regards [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: Users experienced that the reference parameter for wiping relay blocks was inconsistently available due to compatibility issues when working with projects initially created in older software and hardware versions of [product_name]. The issue was resolved by starting a new project, which highlights limited backward compatibility and a lack of clear guidance regarding software feature availability.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the reference parameter option to be consistently available for wiping relays, as specified in documentation and as it is for other timer blocks, regardless of software or hardware version history.
